metadata.title: [BUG]: Can't set A2A protocol version via admin UI.
metadata.author: kimsehwan96

description: ### 🐞 Bug Summary The A2A admin UI doesn't expose A2A procotol version setting form in both edit and create section. And the A2A protocol version set default 1.0. But in some cases A2A protocol version 0.3 might be needed (in my case. now kagent only support 0.3 version). --- ### 🧩 Affected Component Select the area of the project impacted: - [ ] `mcpgateway` - API - [x] `mcpgateway` - UI (admin panel) - [ ] `mcpgateway.wrapper` - stdio wrapper - [ ] Federation or Transports - [ ] CLI, Makefiles, or shell scripts - [ ] Container setup (Docker/Podman/Compose) - [ ] Other (explain below) --- ### 🔁 Steps to Reproduce 1. Open the admin panel and navigate to the A2A Agents tab 2. Look at the **Add New A2A Agent** form. There is no field to choose the A2A protocol version 3. Submit the form. The agent is created and the protocol version is silently set to `1.0`. --- ### 🤔 Expected Behavior The Add and Edit forms should expose a Protocol Version selector so operators can pick between `1.0` and `0.3` when registering or updating an A2A agent. --- ### 📓 Logs / Error Output N/A --- ### 🧠 Environment Info You can retrieve most of this from the `/version` endpoint. | Key | Value | |-----|-------| | Version or commit | `main @ v1.0.1` | | Runtime | `Python 3.11, Gunicorn` | | Platform / OS | `macOS` | | Container | `Docker` | --- ### 🧩 Additional Context (optional)
